categories.main_business_segments: Thunder Software Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on intelligent operating system products and technologies, primarily serving the intelligent automotive, intelligent software, and intelligent IoT sectors. Its key business lines include intelligent automotive systems, intelligent software solutions, and intelligent IoT products, with offerings spanning software development, technical services, software licensing, and integrated hardware-software products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages intelligent operating system technology as its core, emphasizing AI integration, edge computing, cloud computing, and IoT. Key technologies include the native intelligent vehicle operating system 'Drip OS', AI middleware for model integration, 3D rendering engines (Kanzi), AI vision fusion (SmartDrive), and modular robot control platforms. Production methods involve software licensing, customized software development, and sales of software-centric integrated hardware products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ThunderSoft serves global automotive manufacturers, industrial robot manufacturers, smart device producers, and IoT solution providers. Its markets include intelligent vehicles (smart cockpits, autonomous driving), industrial automation (mobile robots, warehouse logistics), AI-enabled consumer electronics (AI glasses, AI PCs, AI smartphones), and cloud-edge integrated IoT platforms. Major customers are automotive OEMs, robot manufacturers, and technology companies worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with R&D centers in 16 countries and regions, including China, the United States, Japan, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Revenue is generated primarily from China (63.63%), with significant growth in overseas markets such as Europe, the US, and Japan. It maintains subsidiaries and joint ventures across Asia, Europe, and North America to support its global business.
categories.supply_chain_position: ThunderSoft operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the technology supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and solution provision for intelligent devices and platforms. It provides IP licensing, software development services, and integrated hardware-software products to OEMs and system integrators, enabling end-product manufacturing and deployment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in intelligent operating systems, edge computing, AI integration, and cloud-edge hybrid architectures. Key initiatives include developing the Drip OS for intelligent vehicles, expanding AI-enabled robotics, advancing AI glasses and mixed reality devices, and enhancing AI PC and smartphone platforms. It invests heavily in AI model integration, middleware, and system frameworks to accelerate AI application deployment across verticals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a combination of software licensing (IP authorization fees), customized software development and technical services (development fees and service charges), and sales of integrated software-hardware products. The company operates a direct sales model and also earns income from investment gains and government subsidies related to its R&D activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ThunderSoft is positioned as a leading provider of intelligent operating systems and AI-enabled edge solutions, particularly in the automotive and industrial robotics sectors. It competes with global software and technology firms in automotive OS, AI middleware, and embedded systems. Strategic partnerships with major chipmakers and cloud providers strengthen its competitive edge, while its global footprint supports its leadership in intelligent edge computing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.38 billion, a 2.72% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 407 million, a 12.6% decrease. It maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~30% of revenue) and has expanded its asset base to RMB 12.5 billion. The company shows a growth trajectory with expanding overseas revenue and improving profitability in the second half of 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ThunderSoft emphasizes its intelligent operating system technology as the foundation for rich, diverse AI-enabled edge applications. Its Drip OS offers chip-agnostic, open, and modular solutions tailored for intelligent vehicles, supporting global automotive ecosystems. The company differentiates through deep AI integration, multi-agent collaboration, and comprehensive software-hardware platforms across automotive, robotics, and consumer electronics, delivering enhanced user experiences and operational efficiencies.
